en_title: Ocarina of Time Remake Will Support All Existing Zelda Amiibo With In-Game Item Bonuses
cn_title: 《塞尔达》《时之笛》重制版兼容旧款amiibo
subtitle: 补给道具到手
opus_summary: 任天堂确认，《时之笛》重制版支持全部现有塞尔达amiibo，可提供回血爱心等道具。新款少年林克与少年塞尔达amiibo可解锁面具，游戏将于11月5日登陆Switch 2。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo just dropped a new overview trailer for the Ocarina of Time remake, offering a fresh look at revamped environments, characters, and combat. We had the chance to play some of the game ourselves , and were surprised by just how many changes Nintendo is making to the iconic N64 release.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂刚刚发布了《时之笛》重制版的全新概览预告片，进一步展示了重新打造的场景、角色和战斗。我们也有机会亲自试玩了部分内容，任天堂对这款N64经典作品所做的改动之多，让我们颇感意外。

paragraphs.en: While Nintendo previously announced two new amiibo figures tied to the remake - Young Link and Young Zelda - the new overview trailer also confirms support for all existing Zelda amiibo. It doesn’t go into too much detail about what that support will involve, but the trailer shows Link receiving a number of helpful items, including healing hearts, Green Potions, and a Deku Stick.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂此前已公布了两款配合重制版推出的全新amiibo，分别是少年林克和少年塞尔达。而这支全新概览预告片还确认，游戏将支持所有现有的塞尔达系列amiibo。预告片没有详细说明具体支持哪些功能，不过画面展示了林克获得多种实用道具，包括可恢复生命值的爱心、绿色药水和德库木棒。

paragraphs.en: Your quest through the vast kingdom of Hyrule begins when The Legend of #Zelda: #OcarinaOfTime comes exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 on Nov 5.
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛》将于11月5日独占登陆Switch 2，届时你将在广阔的海拉鲁王国展开冒险。

paragraphs.en: It appears players can tap existing Zelda amiibo for helpful consumables and items, but not necessarily any exclusive cosmetics or weapons. This is similar to how non-Zelda amiibo worked in Tears of the Kingdom , which allowed for daily “bonus” scans of general Amiibo once per day.
paragraphs.cn: 看来，玩家扫描现有的塞尔达系列amiibo后，可以获得实用的消耗品和道具，但未必能获得专属外观或武器。这与《王国之泪》中非塞尔达系列amiibo的用法类似：玩家每天可以扫描一次普通amiibo，领取每日「额外」奖励。

paragraphs.en: The previously announced Ocarina of Time amiibo, which are up for preorder with varying levels of stock across retailers, will net players wearable masks for Zelda and Link.
paragraphs.cn: 此前公布的《时之笛》amiibo已开放预购，各零售商的库存情况不一。玩家使用这些amiibo后，可以获得供塞尔达和林克佩戴的面具。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo first launched the amiibo product line with the Wii U. Each amiibo comes with a small figure as well as a card that you can scan from Nintendo consoles, netting players various unlocks and bonuses across games.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂最初在Wii U时期推出了amiibo产品线。每款amiibo都附有一个小人偶和一张可用任天堂主机扫描的卡片，让玩家在不同游戏中解锁各种内容、获得奖励。

paragraphs.en: Every mainline Zelda release has been accompanied by new amiibo. Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom Amiibo offered in-game weapons and gear in addition to daily rewards.
paragraphs.cn: 每部塞尔达系列正传作品发售时，都会配套推出新的amiibo。《旷野之息》和《王国之泪》的amiibo除了提供每日奖励，还能让玩家获得游戏内的武器和装备。

paragraphs.en: Amiibo frequently sell out in the lead-up to big game releases, and Zelda is about as big as it gets. While the Switch 2 generation of amiibo continues to be in stock at most retailers, some of the older releases have pretty much disappeared from the internet.
paragraphs.cn: 大作发售前，amiibo经常会售罄，而塞尔达系列无疑是其中最受瞩目的大作之一。虽然Switch 2这一代的amiibo在大多数零售商处仍有库存，但部分老款在网上已经几乎买不到了。

paragraphs.en: For those who are desperate to get their hands on an older release, GameStop offers tons of pre-owned amiibo with a solid ‘Pre-Owned’ guarantee for peace of mind. You’ll also find third-party resellers at Target, Best Buy, and eBay, though it’s always worth comparing prices to a figure’s MSRP at release.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你特别想入手某款老款amiibo，GameStop提供大量二手amiibo，并有可靠的「二手商品」保障，让买家更安心。Target、Best Buy和eBay上也有第三方卖家出售这些产品，不过购买前，最好还是将售价与该款人偶发售时的建议零售价比较一下。
